description.value: Good Earth Coffeehouse is a Canadian café chain serving espresso drinks, fresh baked goods, breakfast items, sandwiches, soups, and desserts. This Vancouver location operates inside an Indigo Books & Music store on Robson Street, a busy retail corridor in the West End. The menu offers a broad range of vegetarian, vegan, and gluten-friendly options, making it a flexible urban refueling stop for cyclists with varying dietary needs.

bike_parking_detail: 5 racks within 100m: stands (2 spaces) at 34m; stands (2 spaces) at 45m; stands (3 spaces) at 69m; stands (2 spaces) at 98m; stands (2 spaces) at 99m. Total: 11 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the address (1033 Robson Street, Vancouver) and phone ((604) 428-0484) match OSM. Menu pages across the site show explicit dietary labels — V (vegetarian), VG (vegan), GF (gluten friendly) — corroborating OSM's diet:vegetarian=yes tag; the 'Order Now' button confirms takeout is available. No evidence for bike parking, water refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or device charging appears anywhere in the website content or OSM tags.
concerns: OSM level=1 tag indicates the café is on the second floor of the Indigo building; accessibility with a loaded bike may be limited.
This location is embedded inside an Indigo Books & Music store ('Indigo Robson Street' is the location identifier used on the website); the café's accessibility depends on the host store being open.
OSM opening hours differ from those listed on the current website — the website value should be treated as more authoritative.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A well-established Canadian café chain on a major Vancouver cycling corridor with food, coffee, and strong vegetarian/vegan options — a practical refueling stop, though bike parking and washroom access should be confirmed on-site.
